request_dir.ask: Folder on the MITS Pro PC where test requests are dropped
request_dir.help: The package writes mhp_<job>.json here (channel, test name, schedule, steps). The person at the console starts that test in MITS Pro (Start Channel(s): the named schedule, the test name) and deletes the request.

results_dir.ask: Folder where the channel's results are exported as CSV when the test ends
results_dir.help: Export from MITS Pro (or its export tool) as CSV with the standard columns, named after the test name (<barcode>_mhp_<job>.csv).

software.ask: MITS Pro version on the PC (for the record)

default_channel.ask: MITS Pro channel name channel_state reports until one is written

allowed_schedules.ask: Schedule file names an agent may queue (JSON list; empty allows any)

voltage_max_v.ask: Highest voltage limit any requested step may ask for (chemistry cap)

result_wait_s.ask: Seconds to wait for the results export before the job fails

poll_s.ask: Seconds between looks at the results folder
